mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and hyperuricemia, which increases uric acid levels that allopurinol is used to treat, potentially reducing allopurinol efficacy and increasing precipitation of uric acid crystals in renal tubules.
action: Monitor renal function and uric acid levels closely; ensure adequate hydration during amphotericin B therapy; consider dose adjustment of allopurinol based on renal function and uric acid monitoring.
